svg.data-weight-note: 24.25 lb (11 kg) with two power supplies and five fan modules installed (Table 9)
svg.data-depth-note: 20.48 in (52.02 cm) excluding the fan and power supply handles (Table 9)
svg.data-qsfp28-speeds: 100 or 40 GbE. Ports 50 and 51 channelize to 4 x 25 or 4 x 10 GbE. Ports 48 to 53 channelize to 2 x 50 GbE (Table 5)
svg.data-power-input-dc: rated -48 to -60 VDC, operating range -44 to -72 VDC, 10 A maximum
svg.data-redundancy-note: two supplies, load-sharing and fully redundant; both should be installed
svg.data-fans: five fan modules, 4+1; the switch runs 30 seconds without thermal shutdown while one is replaced
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 to 40 C (32 to 104 F) normal operation
svg.data-storage-temp: -40 to 70 C (-40 to 158 F) in the shipping container
svg.data-altitude: no performance degradation to 1829 m (6000 ft)
svg.data-virtual-chassis: up to 2 switches of the same model; any non-channelized QSFP28 port (48 to 53) can be a virtual chassis port, from 20.2R1
svg.data-timing: PPS OUT and 10M OUT measurement ports (DIN 1.0/2.3, TTL 5 V); PTP supported
svg.data-optics-qsfp28: 100 GbE or 40 GbE; channelizes as in guide Table 5
svg.data-oob: one RJ-45 management port (MGMT) with link activity and status lamps
